name: marker-resize
description: Issue #32: a connected marker area lifted with the Marker Wrench, confirmed unchanged (markers stay, no box), lifted again and stretched two blocks east (markers drop, a floating box remains), then taken by a Filler placed against it (the floating box becomes the Filler's own box, so there is still exactly one box, and it goes when the Filler is broken). Markers A (0,0,4), B (4,0,4), C (0,0,8); B is dragged to (6,0,4) from (5,0,1), where B and the target are the same distance from the eye. A failed run can leave a floating box over x0-6 z4-8 in the save, which then refuses the lift: delete run-smoke/saves to start over.

steps.label: platform and three markers in an L
right-click marker A to connect the area

steps.name: connected
steps.look: three markers with red lasers along the area's two near edges (A-B along x, A-C along z); no volume box

steps.label: lift the area at marker B

steps.name: lifted
steps.look: a volume box outline over exactly the marker area (x0-4, z4-8, one block tall), its corner at B under the crosshair; the markers still stand

steps.label: confirm without moving (aiming at B still)
B still stands after an unchanged confirm (expect: Test passed)

steps.name: unchanged-confirm
steps.look: same as 'connected': markers and their lasers, NO volume box outline, no dropped marker items

steps.name: stretched
steps.look: the volume box now reaches two blocks further east (x0-6, z4-8) past marker B; markers still stand

steps.label: B is gone after a changed confirm (expect: Test failed)
A is gone too (expect: Test failed)

steps.name: confirmed
steps.look: the markers are gone, three marker items lie on the floor where they stood, and a floating volume box outline spans x0-6, z4-8

steps.label: place a Filler against the box's north face
the Filler's box starts at the old marker A (expect box_minX 40)
and reaches the stretched corner (expect box_maxX 46)

steps.name: filler-took-it
steps.look: the Filler in the foreground; exactly one volume box outline over x0-6 z4-8 (the Filler's own, the floating box turned into it: no second, doubled outline)

steps.name: filler-broken
steps.look: empty floor with the dropped items; no volume box outline: the Filler's box went with it and the floating box did not come back
